title: Ummeede Abbas
body:
umeedein abbas ki tooti
mashk se saara beh gayi pani
mashk se uljha teer sakina
haye teri taqdeer sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
jo sab se mumtaz tha tujhko
jin shaano pa naaz tha tujhko
un pe chali shamsheer sakina
haye teri taqdeer sakina
mashk se uljha teer...
haye teri taqdeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein tanhaai hai har soo
dil se laga kar bhai ke baazu
rote hai shabbir sakina
haye teri taqdeer sakina
mashk se uljha teer...
haye teri taqdeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis mushkil se aaye hai baba
mask o alam ko laaye hai baba
khoon mein bhari tasveer sakina
haye teri taqdeer sakina
mashk se uljha teer...
haye teri taqdeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
tera saqqa khoon mein nahaya
qaime tak pani nahi aaya
ki to bahot tatbeer sakina
haye teri taqdeer sakina
mashk se uljha teer...
haye teri taqdeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab bhi alam abbas ka dekha
yaad aaya sookha mashkeeza
dil pe laga ek teer sakina
haye teri taqdeer sakina
mashk se uljha teer...
haye teri taqdeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaiya ko godhi mein uthaale
jaa qaime mein jaa ke chupale
rota hai baysheer sakina
haye teri taqdeer sakina
mashk se uljha teer...
haye teri taqdeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
gir gaye baazu khaak pe kat kar
ab na chacha aayenge palat kar
hogayi ab taakheer sakina
haye teri taqdeer sakina
mashk se uljha teer...
haye teri taqdeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
laaye hai sheh abbas ke baazu
rok sake to rok le aansu
manzil hai gambheer sakina
haye teri taqdeer sakina
mashk se uljha teer...
haye teri taqdeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir pursa sheh ko diya hai
nauha ye ashkon se kiya hai
akhtar ne tehreer sakina
haye teri taqdeer sakina
mashk se uljha teer...
haye teri taqdeer...
author: Akhtar Sirsvi
